author: Seung Wook
problem: A trip lasts N days and the regular fare on day i is F_i. One-day passes are sold only in batches of D for P yen per batch, and each pass covers any single day; print the minimum total cost (passes may be left unused).
bug_description: The slice f[d*i:d*(i+1)+1] takes D+1 fares per group, so each batch is compared against one extra day that is also counted in the next group.

comments.accurate: Sorts fares high to low and buys a batch for each group of D days when P is cheaper than their fares
comments.wrong_behavior: Sorts fares high to low; each group of D days is priced together with the next day's fare, and a batch is bought when P is cheaper
comments.wrong_location: Group slicing verified; check the loop condition d*i<n, which might skip the last partial group
